arabic text: SAJJAD LAY AY MUSHKIL\nAY SHAAM DA SAFAR E
english translation text: SAJJAD IS BURDENED WITH HARDSHIP\nTHIS IS THE JOURNEY OF SHAAM (SYRIA)

arabic text: AKBAR BHIRA DA KATIL\nABID DA HAMSAFAR
english translation text: THE KILLER OF HIS BROTHER AKBAR\nIS NOW TRAVELLING WITH ABID (SAJJAD)

arabic text: HOYA RIHA JADOWN DA, CHUP CHUP SAJJAD REYNDA
english translation text: SINCE HE WAS FREED, SAJJAD REMAINS SILENTLY GRIEVING

arabic text: PUCHE HAAL KOI ROKE, NA SHAAM DA AY LAINDA
english translation text: IF SOMEONE ASKS HIS CONDITION, HE CRIES, UNABLE TO RECOUNT THE EVENTS OF SHAAM

arabic text: JERE ZULM VEKHAY ABID DUNIYA NU KI KHABAR
english translation text: WHAT OPPRESSIONS ABID (SAJJAD) HAS WITNESSED—HOW COULD THE WORLD EVER KNOW?

arabic text: ASGHAR DA KURTA VEERAN, MERI LEHED VICH RAKHAADE
english translation text: PLACE ASGHAR’S TORN SHIRT IN MY GRAVE

arabic text: EHSAN KAR KABR DA, ABID NISHAN MITTA DE
english translation text: DO ME A FAVOUR ABID—ERASE MY NAME FROM MY GRAVE

arabic text: TERE BAAD AA NA JAAVE MERI KABR TE SHIMR
english translation text: SO THAT AFTER YOU, SHIMR NEVER COMES TO MY GRAVE

arabic text: AKHAY RUBAB ABID, MUSHKIL HAI MERA JEENA
english translation text: RUBAB SAYS TO ABID: IT’S HARD FOR ME TO LIVE ON

arabic text: ASGHAR HAI KARBALA VICH, REH SHAAM GAYI SAKINA
english translation text: ASGHAR REMAINS IN KARBALA, AND SAKINA HAS STAYED IN SHAAM

arabic text: HOYI GOUD MERI KHAALI KIS DI LAGI NAZAR
english translation text: MY LAP HAS BECOME EMPTY—WHOSE EVIL EYE CAUSED THIS?

arabic text: ESS SHAAM DE SHEHER VICH, SHABBIR RUL GAYI AAN
english translation text: IN THE CITY OF SHAAM, SHABBIR (HUSSAIN) HAS BEEN DISRESPECTED

arabic text: DARBAR VEKH VEERAN, TERI MAUT BHUL GAYI AAN
english translation text: LOOK AT THE DESERTED COURT—I HAVE FORGOTTEN EVEN MY OWN DEATH

arabic text: BEEMAR MARR NA JAAVE ZAINAB NU HAI FIQAR
english translation text: ZAINAB WORRIES: MAY THE ILL ONE (SAJJAD) NOT DIE HERE

arabic text: RONDA AI KHOON KAIDI, NAI MARZ KOI PURAANEE
english translation text: THE PRISONER CRIES BLOOD—THIS IS NO ORDINARY ILLNESS

arabic text: AI SHAAM KHA GAYI AI, SAJAD DI JAVANI
english translation text: SHAAM HAS DEVOURED SAJJAD’S YOUTH

arabic text: HOYA ZAEEF YAKDAM BAZAARAN DA ASAR
english translation text: HE BECAME OLD IN AN INSTANT—IT’S THE EFFECT OF THE BAZAARS (MARKETS OF SHAAM)

arabic text: JINN O BASHAR MALAAIK, KARDAY BARRI IBADAT
english translation text: JINN, HUMANS, AND ANGELS ENGAGE IN GREAT WORSHIP

arabic text: LEKIN HAI LA ILA DI, BUNIYAAD AI SHAHAADAT
english translation text: BUT THE FOUNDATION OF LA ILAHA ILLALLAH IS MARTYRDOM

arabic text: AJDA HUSSAIN TERA BEYSHAAK AZEEM TAR
english translation text: HUSSAIN, YOUR PROSTRATION IS UNDOUBTEDLY THE GREATEST OF ALL

arabic text: TANVEER AAVAY MEHDI, KARO MIL KE SAB DUA AY
english translation text: MAY THE LIGHT OF MAHDI (AJTF) ARRIVE—LET US ALL PRAY TOGETHER

arabic text: RUK JAAVE RAT AKHAAN DI, ABID NU CHAIN AAVAY
english translation text: MAY THE NIGHT OF TEARS PAUSE, AND ABID (SAJJAD) FIND PEACE

arabic text: AABAD FAIRR HOVAY AI FATIMA DA GHAR
english translation text: AND MAY THE HOUSE OF FATIMA (SA) FLOURISH ONCE AGAIN
